name: doorman
description: Agent token usage, Security Guard state and held tool calls from the Doorman desktop app, in the editor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Reads the Doorman app's own files in your user directory; nothing from the workspace.

doorman-mark.description: The Doorman mark, for the status bar.

commands.title: Doorman: Review — held calls here, or the app on its Radar

doorman.userDataPath.markdownDescription: Where the Doorman app keeps its data. Leave empty for the platform default: `~/Library/Application Support/Doorman` (macOS), `%APPDATA%\Doorman` (Windows), `~/.config/Doorman` (Linux).

doorman.statusBar.description: Show today's agent token usage and the guard's state in the status bar.

doorman.askInEditor.description: Ask here when the guard holds an agent's tool call, instead of only in the Doorman app's own window.
